verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an official Perplexity CLI (`pplx`) for running web search and fetching query-relevant page snippets from the terminal or a coding agent. It returns ranked results as JSON for shell pipelines and agent tool calls, with no code to write, which fits the AI-native workflow. missing for 10: documented coverage beyond search (e.g. Agent API answers, MCP, admin tasks), detailed install and command reference in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
